The "[[Figrin D'an]] Killer"...This card is one of the best counters to the Rebel's sure fire Force Regeneration Strategy using [[Figrin D'an]]. Played in combination with [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio){{!}}U-3PO]], and you can move an infected droid wherever the Rebels try to run. Since no Rebel would dare leave [[Figrin D'an]] alone at a site, your sure to Trap multiple Rebel characters in the explosion. Should they dare use Figrin D'ans Force Regeneration ability, they risk five destiny draws, each with the potential of setting off the explosion. A simple two card combo that is extremely effective.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-programtrap-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Program Trap]]: The game text changes: “R2-D2 and C-3PO),” becomes “C-3PO or R2-D2),”; “The next time” becomes “When”; “explodes, causing all” becomes “'explodes' (all”; “to be lost.” becomes “with Effect are lost).”. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Program Trap” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
